tokens.name: bg-100
tokens.usage: App background: editor, sidebar, inspector, title bar and status bar.

tokens.name: surface-100
tokens.usage: Editor current line and quiet hover on rows.

tokens.name: surface-200
tokens.usage: Selected tree row, selected problem row, pressed ghost button.

tokens.name: surface-300
tokens.usage: Chips, kbd keys, counters, inline code, folded-region chip, secondary pressed state.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Floating surfaces: popovers, menus, the command palette, dialogs and toasts (always with border-200 and a shadow).

tokens.name: overlay
tokens.usage: Scrim behind dialogs and the command palette.

tokens.name: border-100
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers between columns, panel headers and rows.

tokens.name: border-200
tokens.usage: Control and floating-surface outlines: buttons, inputs, popovers, dialogs. Below 3:1 on bg-100 by design (Vercel-dashboard restraint); controls also carry a label, and focus uses focus-ring, which passes.

tokens.name: text-primary
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on bg-100, every surface-* and surface-raised (dark ≥13:1, light ≥14:1).

tokens.name: text-secondary
tokens.usage: Secondary text: labels, metadata, inactive tabs, breadcrumbs; on bg-100 and every surface-* (≥4.9:1 both themes).

tokens.name: text-tertiary
tokens.usage: Hints, captions, problem codes and comments; on bg-100, surface-100/200/300 and surface-raised (≥4.5:1 both themes).

tokens.name: text-gutter
tokens.usage: Editor line numbers and fold chevrons on bg-100 (≥4.6:1); the current line's number uses text-primary.

tokens.name: text-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled labels only (exempt from contrast minimums); never for information.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: The one primary button per view (Run), toggle-on track, active tab underline.

tokens.name: primary-hover
tokens.usage: Hover state of primary.

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a primary fill (≥15:1).

tokens.name: accent-blue
tokens.usage: Links, focus ring, selection, info state, GET; as text on bg-100 and surface-* (dark 7.6:1, light 5.3:1).

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Passed checks, 2xx status, synced dot, POST; always paired with a check icon or the word (dark 9:1, light 5.3:1 on bg-100).

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Warnings (unknown property), retries, variables in YAML; paired with the triangle icon (dark 11:1, light 5.6:1).

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Errors, failed checks, 4xx/5xx, DELETE, destructive actions; paired with the circle-! icon (dark 6.5:1, light 5.4:1). Lighter than success in light theme by 1:1, so never rely on hue alone: always icon or word.

tokens.name: accent-purple
tokens.usage: Numbers in YAML/JSON and PATCH (dark 8:1, light 7.6:1).

tokens.name: info-subtle
tokens.usage: Background of info callouts; text-primary or accent-blue on it.

tokens.name: info-border
tokens.usage: Border of info callouts.

tokens.name: success-subtle
tokens.usage: Background of success callouts and the 2xx pill; success text on it.

tokens.name: success-border
tokens.usage: Border of success callouts and pills.

tokens.name: warning-subtle
tokens.usage: Background of warning callouts and the inline validation message; warning text on it (light 5.2:1).

tokens.name: warning-border
tokens.usage: Border of warning callouts.

tokens.name: danger-subtle
tokens.usage: Background of error callouts and banners; danger or text-primary on it (light 4.8:1).

tokens.name: danger-border
tokens.usage: Border of error callouts and banners.

tokens.name: diag-error-line
tokens.usage: Full-width tint on an editor line that holds an error.

tokens.name: diag-warning-line
tokens.usage: Full-width tint on an editor line that holds a warning.

tokens.name: selection
tokens.usage: Editor text selection.

tokens.usage: Find-in-file matches.

tokens.name: search-match-active
tokens.usage: The current find match (plus a 1px accent-blue outline).

tokens.name: indent-guide

tokens.name: indent-guide-active
tokens.usage: Indent guide of the block holding the cursor.
